about: Singleton (client and server, one holder each, present from level load in TUT_Avernus_C, WLD_Main_A, SCL_Main_A) holding the loaded navcloud regions: ls::HashMap<Vector3i<int>, navcloud::Region, navcloud::HashTableOps> (macOS signatures of navcloud::TryGetTileInfo / ToTilePos / GetNeighbors take exactly this map as the component). Written by navcloud::RegionSystem (ProcessMemoryData, ProcessObstacles, ProcessAgents, MetaDataRemoval), read by navcloud::PathfindingSystem. The map is written out member by member because its key is a struct (own structs may not be hash keys). Region (0x58 bytes, Windows dtor stride): +0 int32 tile resolution kind (0 -> 2, 1 -> 6 tiles per axis in TryGetTileInfo), +0x08 a 64-byte HashMap whose values are 48-byte HashSets, +0x48 Array<uint8_t> of per-tile data (index = (z*n + y)*n + x, bounded by the array size at +0x54).

evidence.says: bucket array (int32 per bucket) of the HashMap; creator bg3.exe+0x392A420 allocates 0x40 and zeroes it with the HashMap pattern (sizes at +0x1C/+0x2C); destructor thunk bg3.exe+0x6C8250 -> bg3.exe+0x6CFFB0 ends with the HashSet destructor bg3.exe+0x582AD0 on +0. Live: heap pointer.
bucket count; macOS TryGetTileInfo takes the hash modulo the 32-bit integer at +8 of the map. Live server: 0x607 (1543 buckets)
hash chain: TryGetTileInfo follows the chain through the 32-bit entry i of the buffer whose pointer is at +0x10 of the map. Live: capacity 0x400, size 0

Vector3i<int> keys in the buffer pointed to by +0x20 of the map, stride 0xC, count = the 32-bit integer at +0x2C of the map (macOS TryGetTileInfo; Windows dtor bg3.exe+0x6CFFB0 loops up to the 32-bit count at +0x2C of the object). Live: capacity 0x400, size 0

navcloud::Region per key, stride 0x58: Windows dtor bg3.exe+0x6CFFB0 destroys element i (stride 0x58) of the buffer pointed to by +0x30 of the object (Array at +0x48 freed, map at +0x08 destroyed by bg3.exe+0x5E19C0 whose values are 0x30-byte HashSets); macOS GetComponentDestructor<RegionDataComponent> calls navcloud::Region::~Region with the same stride
size of the uninitialised value storage; live 0x400

open_questions: Live instances held an empty map (sizes 0, capacity 0x400): element boundaries of Region are untested live.
Key and value types of Region's inner map at +0x08 (values are 48-byte HashSets) and the 8 bytes at Region+0x00 beyond the int32 kind.
